label: H3 Live Action - Continuous Bilateral Start Chain 8s

evidenceBase.finding: The approved eight-second reciprocal combat source used one dynamic start anchor and no end anchor; this preserved action freedom and avoided terminal pose interpolation.

useWhen: two human fighters must exchange several weighted contacts in one native eight-second source
a forced end anchor slows the shot into pose interpolation or creates a frozen tail
the next shot can inherit a hash-locked active exit frame from the accepted source

durationContract.rule: one uninterrupted native source; never replace its missing action with a five-second connector

geometryContract.reason: matches the owner-approved H3 action geometry while preserving model-safe latent dimensions

required: one dynamic start anchor with SHA-256 and exact render-authorization scope
identity and combat-identity matrices for both fighters
three temporal intervals with reciprocal physical exchanges
active source exit selected only after full-frame causal review
the next take starts from that exact hash-locked moving exit
controlContract.endAnchor: forbidden for continuous melee because the model otherwise spends the take interpolating toward a pose and commonly freezes the tail
controlContract.motion: prompt-guided from one moving contact or propulsion frame; the source is free to complete attacks, reactions, recoveries and an active exit

forbidden: unmotivated hovering or rigid ground sliding
RIFE or Foley used to counterfeit impact
RIFE or upscale before source approval

promptContract.language: English except original dialogue and visible text
promptContract.timelineRule: Begin with ONE UNINTERRUPTED EIGHT-SECOND; write reciprocal action over 0-30%, 30-70% and 70-100%, ending with useful uncontrolled motion rather than a target pose.
promptContract.causalityRule: For every hit: load and propulsion occur first, visible contact occurs next, defender compression and center-of-mass travel begin only after contact, then both recover.
promptContract.groundingRule: Every grounded translation is paid by stepping, pivoting, skidding, rolling or dragging; every airborne arc begins with propulsion or contact and ends with support.
promptContract.bilateralRule: Both fighters attack, block or evade and regain initiative; no polite turn-taking, passive target or one-sided pose sequence.
promptContract.junctionRule: Select a real active exit from the accepted MP4 and hash-lock it as the next take's sole start anchor; assemble by direct kinetic cut with duplicate boundary frame removed.
promptContract.readabilityRule: Keep contact and foot support readable; do not hide causal beats with effects, framing, shake or debris.
